defs.def: the facts, signs or objects that make you believe that sth is true 根据；证明；证据

ex.s: Until recently, scientific evidence had been limited to one aspect of morality: kindness.
ex.t: 直到最近，科学证据还仅限于道德的一个方面：善良。

ex.s: The good news is that there is evidence we can learn to change our own story.
ex.t: 好消息是，有证据表明我们可以学会改写自己的人生故事。

ex.s: New evidence suggests, however, that rainfall — particularly increasing autumn rain — is now contributing significantly to permafrost loss.
ex.t: 然而，新的证据表明，降雨——尤其是日益增多的秋季降雨——如今正显著加剧永久冻土的消融。

ex.s: New evidence should be found to back up research findings.
ex.t: 应当找到新的证据来支撑研究成果。

ex.s: Now, more evidence has been provided that dogs distinguish between similar actions associated with different intentions.
ex.t: 如今，有更多证据表明，狗能区分与不同意图相关的相似动作。

ex.s: Supporting evidence for the research results.

"There is a lot of really interesting evidence which seems to be suggesting that if children are inspired up to the age of seven, then being outdoors will be a habit for life." His own children have got into the habit of playing outside now: "We just send them out into the garden and tell them not to come back in for a while."
ex.t: “有大量非常有趣的证据似乎表明，如果孩子在七岁前受到启发，那么户外生活就会成为一生的习惯。”他自己的孩子们现在也养成了在外面玩的习惯：“我们只是把他们赶到花园里，告诉他们一会儿别回来。”

ex.s: While they are rare north of 88°,there is evidence   61   they range all the way across the Arctic, and as far south as James Bay in Canada.
ex.t: 虽然它们在北纬88°以北地区很少见，但有证据表明它们的活动范围遍布整个北极，向南远至加拿大的詹姆斯湾。

ex.s: According to a review of evidence in a medical journal, runners live three years  61  (long) than non-runners.
ex.t: 根据一份医学期刊的证据综述，跑步者比不跑步者多活____61____（长）三年。

ex.s: The most hopeful data shared in the report shows clear evidence of parents serving as examples and important guides for their kids when it comes to reading.
ex.t: 报告中分享的最令人振奋的数据清楚地表明，在阅读方面，家长为孩子树立榜样和发挥重要引导作用。

ex.s: “That is only evidence that traditions once existed,” he said.
ex.t: “那只是传统曾经存在过的证据，”他说。

ex.s: Take a look online—evidence shows that thousands of teachers and parents know a good thing when they see it and recommend TOKNOW to their friends.
ex.t: 上网看看吧——证据表明，成千上万的老师和家长一眼就能看出这是个好东西，并把 TOKNOW 推荐给他们的朋友。

ex.s: Now we have the most direct evidence yet that he is right.
ex.t: 现在我们有最直接的证据，证明他是对的。

ex.s: Facts are statements that can be proved by evidence.
ex.t: 事实是可以被证据证明的陈述。

ex.s: It was just an idea, but enough to inspire Darwin to look for more evidence.
ex.t: 这只是一个想法，但足以激励达尔文去寻找更多的证据。

ex.s: There is evidence that all the different iguanas have developed from more 7____________ones and share a common 8________.
ex.t: 有证据表明，所有不同的鬣蜥都是由更 7____________ 的品种进化而来，并共享一个共同的 8________。

ex.s: Reasons: Evidence: 3 Give your talk to the class.
ex.t: 理由： 证据： 3 向全班展示你的演讲。

ex.s: When you give your opinion, your argument will be stronger if it is supported by evidence.
ex.t: 当你发表观点时，如果有证据支持，你的论点会更有说服力。

ex.s: A comprehensive study of 4, 500 children conducted by the National Institutes of Health in 2018 shows that children who spent more than seven hours a day staring at screens showed evidence of premature thinning of their brain's cortex-the outer layer that processes sensory information.
ex.t: 美国国立卫生研究院 2018 年对 4500 名儿童开展的一项综合研究表明，每天盯着屏幕超过七小时的儿童，其大脑皮层出现了提前变薄的证据——皮层是处理感觉信息的外层。

defs.def: the information that is used in court to try to prove sth （法庭上的）证据，证词，人证，物证
